themes.title: Right-wing parties push anti-immigration policies in Europe
themes.blurb: Across Europe, right-wing and far-right parties are intensifying their focus on anti-immigration policies, framing them as national priorities. This theme is evident in Spain, Norway, the UK, Germany, Italy, and France, where parties like Vox, Fremskrittspartiet, Reform UK, AfD, Fratelli d'Italia, Lega, and Rassemblement National are advocating for stricter border controls, prioritizing national citizens in social services, and criticizing government responses to immigration crises.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes government for 'pull effect' on immigration and demands stricter border controls in Ceuta and Andalusia.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Advocates for stricter immigration policies and local governance reforms to address demographic challenges.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Proposes criminalizing non-English election materials and tightening immigration controls.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls with anti-immigration rhetoric, criticizing government policies and proposing stricter controls.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Supports stricter immigration policies and prioritizes national security, with Salvini emphasizing immigration as a greater threat than Russia.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Focuses on anti-immigration policies as a cornerstone of its 2027 presidential campaign, criticizing Macron's approach.

themes.title: Iran threatens Western leaders amid escalating tensions
themes.blurb: Iran's aggressive posturing and threats against Western leaders have become a dominant transnational theme, with right-wing and far-right media amplifying the narrative of escalating geopolitical tensions. This theme is particularly prominent in the U.S., Italy, France, the UK, Spain, and Hungary, where leaders and media outlets are framing Iran as a direct threat to Western security and sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump escalates rhetoric against Iran, announces Strait of Hormuz blockade, and imposes fees on ships, framing Iran as a direct threat to U.S. interests.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni is targeted in Iranian media, with right-wing outlets amplifying the threat narrative and emphasizing Italy's role in countering Iran.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Le Pen's party highlights Iran's threats as part of its broader critique of Macron's foreign policy, positioning itself as a stronger alternative.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage and Reform UK amplify Iran threat narrative, linking it to broader concerns about national security and immigration.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes government for not taking a stronger stance against Iran, framing it as part of a broader failure to protect national sovereignty.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Amplifies Iran threat narrative, positioning Hungary as a defender of European sovereignty against external threats.

themes.title: Far-right leaders face legal and political challenges
themes.blurb: Far-right leaders across multiple countries are confronting significant legal and political challenges, ranging from criminal investigations to internal party divisions. This theme is evident in France, Spain, Hungary, the UK, the U.S., and Poland, where leaders like Marine Le Pen, Santiago Abascal, Viktor Orbán, Nigel Farage, Donald Trump, and Jarosław Kaczyński are navigating legal scrutiny, internal dissent, and public backlash.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Marine Le Pen faces legal challenges, including convictions and fines, while navigating internal party dynamics ahead of the 2027 presidential election.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Santiago Abascal and Vox face legal scrutiny over hate speech allegations and internal disputes with coalition partners.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Orbán and Fidesz face internal divisions, legal challenges, and public protests over constitutional changes and corruption allegations.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Nigel Farage faces legal scrutiny over security arrangements, party finances, and internal disputes following Ann Widdecombe's death.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump faces multiple legal challenges, including IRS lawsuits, investigations into election interference, and scrutiny over foreign policy decisions.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Kaczyński and PiS face internal divisions, legal challenges over corruption allegations, and public backlash over controversial statements.

themes.title: Javier Milei’s economic reforms spark global right-wing emulation
themes.blurb: Javier Milei's radical economic reforms in Argentina are inspiring right-wing and libertarian movements globally, with leaders in the U.S., Spain, the UK, and Italy looking to emulate his policies. This theme highlights the transnational appeal of Milei's deregulation, austerity, and anti-inflation measures, as well as the political challenges he faces in implementing them.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Milei pushes for Central Bank reform, deregulation, and austerity measures, facing both domestic opposition and international interest.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Trump and U.S. conservatives praise Milei's reforms, with some advocating for similar deregulation and austerity measures in the U.S.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox supports Milei's economic policies, using them as a model for Spain and criticizing the Spanish government's economic management.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Reform UK cites Milei's reforms as inspiration for its own economic policies, particularly in deregulation and reducing government spending.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Italian right-wing parties, including Lega, express interest in Milei's economic model, particularly his approach to deregulation and inflation control.

themes.title: Right-wing parties clash over electoral reforms
themes.blurb: Electoral reforms are a contentious issue among right-wing parties in Europe, with debates over preference voting, proportional representation, and constitutional changes creating divisions. This theme is particularly evident in Italy, Hungary, Spain, and Poland, where parties like Fratelli d'Italia, Lega, Fidesz, Vox, and PiS are navigating internal and external conflicts over electoral laws.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini clash over electoral reforms, particularly the reintroduction of preference voting, with internal divisions threatening coalition unity.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Orbán and Fidesz face internal dissent over constitutional changes and electoral reforms, with Gulyás Gergely resigning in protest.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox pushes for electoral reforms, including prioritizing national citizens in social services and challenging government policies on voting rights.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: PiS faces internal divisions over electoral reforms, including proposals to block Ukraine's EU accession and changes to Poland's electoral laws.
